lessons.claim: A desktop screenshot shows the owner is signed into AI Studio.
lessons.fruit: The cloud browser was redirected to Google sign-in and exposed no transferable browserAuth capability.
lessons.rule: Treat browser sessions as trust-boundary local; never infer runtime credentials or copy cookies.
lessons.regression: Connector can use WIF/metadata identity without browser state.

lessons.claim: A signed-in personal account can authorize cloud automation.
lessons.fruit: The runtime had no API key, ADC, gcloud session or generic operator permission.
lessons.rule: Prove the exact caller identity in the exact execution route immediately before an effect.
lessons.regression: Cloud preflight prints the active WIF account and stops on failure.

lessons.claim: A Service Usage 403 proves all Google Cloud access is blocked.
lessons.fruit: The denial was tied to caller project 979287460558 while the target estate is project 257649435135.
lessons.rule: Keep caller project, quota project and target project separate; route-specific denials are not universal conclusions.
lessons.regression: Workflow pins and reads back the target project before deployment.

lessons.claim: Project Owner is the easiest automation role.
lessons.fruit: Prior records showed broad Owner grants to runtime identities.
lessons.rule: Use dedicated deployer and runtime identities with least privilege; no connector path may grant Owner.
lessons.regression: Deployment workflow only audits runtime roles and cannot mutate IAM.

lessons.claim: An API key in a document makes AI Studio usable.
lessons.fruit: A historical plaintext key was quarantined and cannot be safely reused.
lessons.rule: Keys are optional, Secret-Manager-only inputs; prefer WIF and service identity.
lessons.regression: Repository contains no credential value and Vertex mode needs no key.

lessons.claim: A deployment package or workflow means the service is deployed.
lessons.fruit: Repository workflows existed but provider-side run/readback evidence was unavailable.
lessons.rule: Separate IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, PUBLISHED, DEPLOYED and PROVEN states.
lessons.regression: Build contract keeps deployed/proven false without provider readback.

lessons.claim: Any audio locator works on both Gemini providers.
lessons.fruit: Official docs distinguish Developer uploads/inline data from Vertex Cloud Storage inputs.
lessons.rule: Reject unsupported source/provider combinations before model invocation.
lessons.regression: Developer mode rejects gs:// and Vertex rejects non-gs URIs.

lessons.fruit: Official safety guidance requires post-processing and human evaluation.
lessons.rule: Hash inputs and outputs, preserve uncertainty and label every model transcript for human verification.
lessons.regression: Transcription tests assert the evidentiary status and integrity fields.

lessons.claim: Speaker names supplied in a prompt are verified identities.
lessons.fruit: Model diarization can infer or misattribute speakers.
lessons.rule: Treat supplied speaker names as hints and require UNKNOWN markers when uncertain.
lessons.regression: The system prompt forbids invented identities and requires uncertainty markers.

lessons.claim: Retries are harmless for expensive multimodal calls.
lessons.fruit: Repeated calls can duplicate spend and create conflicting outputs.
lessons.rule: Use body-bound idempotency keys, bounded retries outside the connector and explicit conflict detection.
lessons.regression: Identical calls replay; changed bodies return 409.

lessons.fruit: Fallback can cross billing, data-governance and authentication boundaries without notice.
lessons.rule: Auto selects once from configuration; never silently fall back after a provider error.
lessons.regression: Each request has one provider and reports it.

lessons.claim: A corpus sweep is complete after a search returns results.
lessons.fruit: The Drive review required 198 paginated searches, deduplication and tab-level reads.
lessons.rule: Completion requires pagination closure, deduplication and exact readback of targeted records.
lessons.regression: Future corpus jobs must publish page counts, unique counts and unresolved surfaces.

lessons.claim: Conversation history is sufficient operational memory.
lessons.fruit: Long workstreams compact and cross-chat consumers cannot inspect hidden history.
lessons.rule: Commit immutable Local Bible transactions and publish reusable lessons with source, fruit, rule and regression test.
lessons.regression: Lessons registry validates and is included in the handoff set.

lessons.claim: A feature count proves market superiority.
lessons.fruit: A large list can disguise unimplemented capabilities.
lessons.rule: Every feature carries a truthful state and acceptance condition; counts are not completion claims.
lessons.regression: Feature-registry validation enforces state and acceptance fields.

lessons.claim: A successful liveness probe proves model access.
lessons.fruit: Health can succeed without billing, API or IAM permissions.
lessons.rule: Keep liveness, configuration readiness, cloud preflight, canary health and semantic model proof separate.
lessons.regression: The workflow runs billing/API/IAM preflight before deployment and model proof remains a separate state.
